definitions.explanation: A defeat or loss, originally from the filled black circle (●) used to mark losses in sumo records and other competition results. Widely used in sports and competitive contexts.

definitions.gloss: black mark; failure; blot on one's record
definitions.explanation: A failure or blemish on one's record, reputation, or track record. Used figuratively beyond sports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{黒星|くろぼし}だった。
⟦{横綱|よこづな}→横綱：14957_yokozuna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まさか→まさか：03732_masaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黒星|くろぼし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喫|きっ}した→喫する：29124_kissuru⟧。
examples.english: The grand champion suffered an unexpected defeat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{開幕|かいまく}→開幕：08174_kaimaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧{黒星|くろぼし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{士気|しき}→士気：19824_shiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がっている→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: Team morale is down after three consecutive losses from the start of the season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経歴|けいれき}→経歴：13795_keireki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{黒星|くろぼし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく。
examples.english: It puts a black mark on your record.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{黒星|くろぼし}だ。
examples.english: The failure of this project is a big black mark.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{黒星|くろぼし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけたく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}もう→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to get a mark against me here, so let's give it everything we've got.

notes:
From the notation system used in sumo and other sports where ● (black circle) marks a loss and ○ (white circle) marks a win. The opposite is ⟦{白星|しろぼし}→白星：19036_shiroboshi⟧ (win).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒星|くろぼし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喫|きっ}する→喫する：29124_kissuru⟧ — to suffer a defeat (formal)
- {黒星|くろぼし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく — to get a loss/black mark on one's record
- {黒星|くろぼし}⟦{先行|せんこう}→先行：03773_senkou⟧ — more losses than wins
- ⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧{黒星|くろぼし} — consecutive losses

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{白星|しろぼし}→白星：19036_shiroboshi⟧ — win, victory (opposite)
- ⟦{敗北|はいぼく}→敗北：12872_haiboku⟧ — defeat (formal, general)
- ⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧ — loss, defeat (casual)
